steps.content: Following the earlier battle, the monsters' sightings have not diminished—they have become more frequent somehow. Even when repelled, they simply withdraw into the shadows, biding their time for another opportunity to attack.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Something's wrong with the pressure gauge readings. We shouldn't be descending this fast. Is it the monsters' doing?

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: It's okay. We'll be fine. This won't happen again, probably...
Ragnar, his eyebrows knit in a frown, has completely forgotten that he had asked you to give warnings. He steers the submarine while attempting to reassure you, the only "child" on the team.

Disregarding Ragnar's comforting, you focus on recalling the monsters' traits. The first one you encountered was hideous in appearance but not inherently aggressive—Pylgia even managed to pacify it initially.

Nevertheless, as the battle persists, the newly appearing monsters become increasingly fearsome. They exhibit nothing but hostility towards any movement, launching attacks at every chance when their numbers amass.
Has the combat heightened their aggression? Or perhaps...
Thud—
An abrupt loud thump startles you out of your thoughts, and you turn to Ragnar at the helm.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Damn it! A monster on the port side!
At Ragnar's call, Pylgia immediately swims to check.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: No creature spotted. Just a reef.
As Pylgia shines her searchlight, you all look over. The "monster" reveals itself to be nothing more than a deformed coral rock.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: Shoot... Alright.
Ragnar mutters under his breath, but the tension remains unbroken both inside and out. The frequent battles have left everyone on edge.

As the searchlight beam moves away, everything outside fades back into darkness. In the porthole, you catch a glimpse of yourself—a child sporting a red neckerchief, referred to by the expedition as the "little guide."
Yet when you look down at yourself, both your body and clothes appear completely normal—being the same adult in this realm as you are in the real world.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, this place does have the truth about my past...
Your past self, the expedition's fate... Your mind starts to wander as you recall Ragnar's earlier joking about "being taken by sea monsters."
The previous nightmare of falling into the vast void... Could that be a forewarning of things to come?
The darkness answers not, akin to the bottomless pit from your dream, only mirroring your unsettled silhouette.
Silence reigns, with only the persistent static from the radio filling the space. The ambiance becomes oppressively dense, making it hard to catch a breath.
Knock, knock...
A rhythmic tapping comes from the porthole.
You glance up to see Pylgia, floating there in full diving gear. Silence falls again between you, but this time, through her diving mask, her gaze is steadier as if trying to calm your unease.
Capturing your focus, she gracefully glides away a little, unveiling a cluster of white, softly bioluminescent plankton floating into the spot she previously occupied.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are they trying to... greet me?
Pylgia nods at you. Then—maybe it's just your mind playing tricks—the white creatures begin to move, arranging themselves into a playful smile.
You rub your eyes in disbelief, yet the luminous smile has already vanished. The plankton revert to their original state, swimming aimlessly around Pylgia.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They seem... fond of you?
Pylgia gently touches one of the luminous beings with her finger and answers with certainty.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Yes, because I can understand what they're trying to convey.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So you really can understand these deep-sea creatures? What are they saying?
Pylgia falls silent, seemingly contemplating her response. Meanwhile, the white creatures position themselves above her head in a dotted line that strikingly resembles an ellipsis.
Faced with Pylgia's prolonged silence, you decide to break the ice discreetly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I wish I could understand what these little ones are saying too...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Once we complete our mission and leave this place, could you teach me how to talk to them?
This time, Pylgia responds with a firm nod.
The submarine rocks slightly in the turbulent currents. Pylgia casts a glance downward and waves at you.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: We're approaching the target location. I'll go find a suitable spot to dock.
Pylgia returns to her duties, but not before giving you a nod that seems to say, "See you soon."
In this brief private moment, you glimpse a spark of life beneath her reserved facade.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Being a child sometimes does work wonders...
You smile and then glance back to where the luminescent creatures were, only to find that they have vanished without a trace.
Under Pylgia's guidance, the submarine descends to the white sandy seabed, swaying gently.
While Ragnar and Dale, relieved and convinced their mission is half complete, see only hope, what you see outside is the stark opposite—an omen of anything but a safe return.
Beneath you stretches a vast void of infinite darkness, the submarine anchoring right at its edge.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is... the place in my dream.
